selection_analysis.selection_reason: From the 174-case state, prim.tool.lifecycle remains the highest-leverage residual primitive at 111. All remaining closed-primary tool clusters are one case on one receipt. TOOL-025 wins the reuse tie-break because Batch 11 already provides both ToolDecision→ToolProposal ownership semantics and the no-ToolExecution predicate. The only incremental semantic surface is parameterizing decision resolution for allow and bounding allow against execution inference. This is smaller than opening new invocation-without-proposal, execution-state, cancellation, validation, verifier, claim-strength, privacy, adapter, taint, model-output, or provider surfaces.
